basis: B12 147 subjects minus 23 physically downloaded original JPEG targets from B15 (irrespective of correctness), plus 14 Commons exact-object file-page leads
classification_rule: Distinguish no-binary from no-usable-photo: 124 still no original bytes; B15's 12 wrong+2 uncertain add 14 further unusable positions; nine B15 plausibles still await approval.
safety: No free-text Commons result may be downloaded as an object-photo assignment.
The next B16 strict acquirer may only retrieve previously listed exact Commons file titles; historical or artwork/rights holds never release automatically.
Caption-matched photos are not visually or legally verified originals.
One physical object may have several photos, but a second reliquary or a chapel exterior is not the same physical object.
No changes to 20 historic user KEEP approvals, and no publication.
